text:
Sophie L.: quick heads-up — LangChain reached out about listing their connector in the cloud marketplace + bundling it with our gateway. main ask: confirm our SSO story (OIDC group claims + SP-initiated flow) and a lightweight test plan they can run with us. cc @Raj @Marco :wave:

Raj P.: we support OIDC and accept group claims today, but there are two things to call out: 1) our default token audience differs from LC's example, 2) we require `email_verified` for provisioning. can you share their expected claim set?

Sophie L.: they sent a sample payload in the thread — looks like `groups`, `email`, `preferred_username`. they prefer SP-initiated SSO for SSO-first provisioning.

Marco G.: infra note — for marketplace bundles we need a dedicated tenant mapping step so we don't mix tenant configs. small infra change but low-risk. ETA 2 business days if nothing else blocks. :+1:

Elaine (PM): marketing asks to lock demo date. can we have a smoke test by Tue next week? that gives them time to validate before announcement. also need a short FAQ for support.

Raj P.: ok. proposed smoke-test steps for partner: 1) create a test app in their IdP, 2) configure OIDC with redirect to our SP URL, 3) include `groups` and `email_verified` claims, 4) do SP-initiated sign-on and verify provisioning into a staging tenant. sample config we can share:

```
issuer: https://idp.partner-example.com
client_id: LC-staging-123
redirect_uri: https://staging.redwood.ai/sso/callback
requested_claims: ["email","email_verified","groups","preferred_username"]
```

Raj P.: add note — if they can't set `email_verified`, we can accept `email` + manual verify checkbox in staging for the demo.

Sophie L.: that works. can you also add a small script or curl example to exchange code for token so their infra team can validate quickly?

Raj P.: yep — I'll paste a minimal curl in the doc.

Marco G.: one more: marketplace bundle requires a permission matrix file (json) describing which roles map to Redwood console roles. I can draft a template.

Elaine (PM): timeline check — Raj + Marco: deliver artifacts (curl example, role-mapping template, short smoke-test doc) by EOD Fri? then Sophie will schedule the partner runthrough Mon. :calendar:

Raj P.: EOD Fri is fine. I'll open a doc in the partner repo and ping here when ready.

devops-bot: deploy-checker: staging SSO webhook test endpoint returned 200 for /sso/test at 2024-11-15T10:12:45Z.

Sophie L.: awesome, thanks all. i'll relay timeline to LangChain and ask them to share the IdP test config. :thumbsup:

Marco G.: tagging QA: we should include a malformed-claims case (missing groups) so partner knows fallback behavior. will add to the test plan.

Elaine (PM): adding this to the partner launch checklist. thanks team!
